answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because velvet only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, nadir is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
